Chris receives a call from a sick fisherman. The weather improves and a large wall of ice forms on the lake. This phenomenon worries all teams. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Steve Backshall: extreme river | S01E01
programme.desc: Explorer and naturalist Steve Backshall takes on the most difficult challenge of his life - he wants to be the first to completely swim the Baliem River in Indonesia. During this dangerous expedition, the explorer will visit one of the world's last cannibal tribes, try to catch a huge saltwater crocodile and admire the astonishingly beautiful birds of paradise. Naturalist Steve Backshall takes on the most difficult challenge of his life - he wants to be the first to swim across the Baliem River in Indonesia. There are many dangers ahead of him, a jungle, a rushing current and undiscovered caves. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Steve Backshall: extreme river | S01E02
programme.desc: Explorer and naturalist Steve Backshall takes on the most difficult challenge of his life - he wants to be the first to completely swim the Baliem River in Indonesia. During this dangerous expedition, the explorer will visit one of the world's last cannibal tribes, try to catch a huge saltwater crocodile and admire the astonishingly beautiful birds of paradise. Steve wants to swim the unclimbed wild Baliem River in Indonesia. He fights against a rushing current, breaks through a dangerous jungle and visits one of the last tribes of cannibals in the world. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Spies in the snow
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary record funny and dramatic situations involving penguins, polar bears and sea otters. To be able to take a closer look at their heroes, they let spies into their ranks - dummy animals with cameras installed. They go to hard-to-reach, snowy Alaska. The first emissary, an artificial otter, is tasked with filming a mother and her newborn children. Despite the cold, otters can give birth even in the middle of winter. The young are protected by a down blanket. A human eye will accompany the family until the ice melts and the baby takes its first steps in independent life. Some of the material was obtained thanks to a camera placed... in an artificial snowball that moves using invisible elements. It is a true technological marvel, equipped with a self-aligning lens. The artificial bald eagle, on the other hand, uses drone technology. Designed to be indistinguishable from living birds, it allows you to observe nature from above... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Snow creatures
programme.desc: Animals must have a variety of tactics prepared to survive in one of the coldest places on our planet. From finding a convenient place to hunt to a shelter where they can raise their offspring. Nature film presenter Liz Bonnin will show viewers how animals cope in such difficult conditions... Great Britain. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: A plane crash occurs in the middle of the Arctic tundra. The only passenger on the plane is Overgard (Mads Mikkelsen), who manages to escape unscathed. At first, he believes that help will come soon and he persistently maintains some semblance of communication with the world by broadcasting a radio message about his situation. One day, hope for rescue appears when Overgard sees the outline of a helicopter on the horizon. However, it crashes into the ice. A girl found in the wreck motivates him to act. Feeling responsible for the stranger, despite the extreme conditions and numerous frostbites, the man decides to travel to a distant research station. The main character is played by the winner of the Palme d'Or for the 2012 film The Hunt... Iceland. 2018. adventure drama

programme.title: Gladiators of the animal world – Wild Coast | E02
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world... Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Lion Rules – Hide and Seek | E03
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. During the rainy season, the vegetation turns green rapidly, making it difficult for the lions to camouflage. Einstein tries to make new bonds, but he finds it very difficult. Mad-Eye Moody kidnaps Keeza and her pup. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Sharks vs. killer whales
programme.desc: The great white shark is not at the top of the food chain. His power means he could be on it. However, killer whale attacks made them the kings of the oceans. The creators will take a look at these majestic creatures and wonder if sharks have any chance against them... Great Britain. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: Wild Canada – Autumn | S01E03
programme.desc: Four beautifully filmed and well-edited episodes that show the history of the part of North America that lies beyond the Arctic Circle. The documentary uses incredible aerial photography and astonishing time-lapse footage. They cover areas from the east coast to the west, from the plains to the wilderness, from vast expanses of grassy prairies to the cold, lifeless landscapes of the Arctic. This is the beating heart of true wild Canada. Viewers will see the high cliffs of Newfoundland, the wild Pacific coast and the Hudson Bay area where the great migration begins. USA, Great Britain, Austria, Canada. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Matsalu moose: Estonian giants
programme.desc: Estonian Matsalu National Park on the north-eastern coast of the Baltic Sea is an important stopover for migrating birds and home to many protected species of plants and animals. programme.title: 30 for 30: Long Gone Summer
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

S1, Ep2 «Chasing the Rains»…Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta's loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob | In this dramatic series, we follow three animal matriarchs as they protect their families while surviving one of the worst droughts in twenty years | Director: Nigel Pope, Jackie Savery | Cast: Adjoa Andoh

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack: Kakumbi Are Vulnerable (S2E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2023. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S2, Ep4 «Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack»…Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP's lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory | Cameraman Julz Braatvedt returns to the South Luangwa National Park to see the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakuli packs back in action alongside lions, warthogs, buffalo, leopards, elephants and hyenas | Cast: Julian Braatvedt

programme.title: Chasing the Rains: The Fickle River (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Prancūzija, 2022. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Prancūzija. Год: 2022. S1, Ep1 «Chasing the Rains»…Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. programme.title: Mysteries Of the Mekong: The Journey Begins (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China's land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals | Travel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. From there, its path continues through Cambodia and, finally, into Vietnam where the majestic delta splits into nine channels that feed into the South China Sea. Each epsiode focuses on a particular section of the river and, along the way, we get to meet such creatures as snub-nosed monkeys, high-flying birds and never before filmed cave dwellers | Director: Peter Ringgaard, Oliver Page | Cast: Leila Monks

programme.title: Deep Dive North America: Changing Tides (S1E6). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2024. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep6 «Deep Dive North America»…Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish | Strap in for a thrilling ride as Lizzie travels by air, land, and sea to meet Alaskan wildlife and visit the world's remotest corners. Eavesdrop on underwater Arctic residents with scientists, dine with polar bears, and scavenge with bald eagles | Director: Mark Woodward | Cast: Lizzie Daly

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa: The Garden Route (S2E1) (Great Parks Africa). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2016. S2, Ep1
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2016. S2, Ep1 «Great Parks Africa»…In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here – from the magnificent, to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park | Jump into Africa's stunning national parks, home to some of the most diverse and magnificent wildlife species on our planet, as we explore their natural glory in this brilliant documentary series. Renowned for its big game and breathtaking safaris, Africa accommodates thousands of tourists every year who yearn to glimpse these beautiful creatures. In Great Parks of Africa we give viewers the chance to explore these majestic natural parks and sanctuaries, from Addo Elephant to Table Mountain, Kgalagadi Transfrontier to Karoo, showcasing the diverse wildlife that inhabit these havens | Director: Werner Hefer

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: The Road to Recovery (S2E7). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S2, Ep7
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep7 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Beni and Lala get an unexpected visit from Vet Arga, Kesi makes a new friend on Bangamat Island, and Alejandra deals with a new view of the world after the accident at forest school leaves her blind in one eye | Captivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School» | Director: Judith Curran | Cast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Arctic Secrets: Yukon Wild (S2E2). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2017. S2, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep2 «Arctic Secrets»…The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call «Yu-kun- ah», or, the «great river». The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea | With its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. This documentary series takes a look at the people and animals for whom the Arctic is home. We see how Inuit tribes, orcas, polar bears and more survive the challenges of living in the severe climate of the northernmost part of our planet. The tribes and species of the Arctic have spent thousands of years learning how to adapt to the change of the seasons. They must now adapt to a new threat; the impact of climate change | Director: Allan Code

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 9 p.
programme.desc: Poppy was brutally attacked by a large dog. Tim tries to save Poppy the koala, who is unable to care for her baby. Audrey and Alison try to figure out why rescue cat Candy can't get up. Cast: Andrew Marchevsky, Chris Brown, Lisa Chimes, Tim Faulkner, Ben Dessen, Elissa Sursara, Dean Gladstone, Trent "Maxi" Maxwell, Steve Oemcke. Australia, 2009

programme.title: Conversations with animals. The last white giraffe
programme.desc: A documentary about the most unusual and touching stories of friendship between people and animals. You will see how a man saves a bird, and it in turn becomes his true friend. We will also tell you about a dog that becomes a blood donor for other animals, saving lives. Let's not ignore the funny competitions of ferrets, which amaze with their courage and dexterity, as well as the story of a dachshund, who spent six years of her life in a wheelchair, but did not lose either optimism or spirit. Australia, 1993, educational

programme.title: In the animal world. 18 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: Not the heavenly life of the Garden of Eden. 2 s.
programme.desc: The Singapore Botanic Garden is the only tropical garden recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. There is an incredible variety of tropical flora and fauna here. Together with the local inhabitants, we will spend a year of our lives and see the dramatic life of wild nature hidden from prying eyes. Singapore, 2022, educational

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Lords of the Sky
programme.desc: Eagles and other “lords of the skies” play a key role in the wildlife food chain. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. American mountains
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 9 p.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 10 s.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animal families. 8 p.
programme.desc: Big or small, they all form a community where members care for each other, communicate and learn together. We're going around the world to find out how they work. We will learn how they improve natural instincts and acquire life skills. Let's study their life in nature from all sides. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/f Wildlife of Lapland. The birth of the fjelds, the polar night and the northern lights
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the rugged magic of Lapland. This episode takes you through the snow-covered hills under the stars of the polar night to witness the most spectacular show on Earth - the dance of the Northern Lights in the realm of the wild. Finland, 2024

programme.title: d/f Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The Caribbean archipelago is a chain of islands containing unique specimens of wildlife. Life took hold in this isolated environment, carried by winds, migrating birds or sea waves. Today these islands offer some of the richest biological resources in the world. This film explores this fascinating yet fragile wild Caribbean and its exceptional ecosystems. France, 2018

programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore. Hidden Wildlife
programme.desc: We have a fascinating journey through the city, where among the skyscrapers and highways there is an incredible diversity of wildlife, including rare species that were caught on camera for the first time. Dir.: Bill Morris, John Ruthven. UK, 2016

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Under cover of night
programme.desc: Nocturnal animals use darkness to hide from predators and the scorching sun, and also to get food. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared. Disappearance or return
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea, 2023

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. The strongest
programme.desc: Mighty grizzly bears. Tiny strong ants. A swift, inimitable throw of a crocodile. Indestructible armor of the rhinoceros beetle. Who will be called the strongest on our planet? USA, 2012

programme.desc: A biographical film about one of the most famous football players in the world, Cristiano Ronaldo. Before becoming a world football star, Cristiano had to go through many difficulties in his sports career. Like many, Ronaldo started out playing street football, running with friends through the streets of the small seaside town of Funchal in Portugal. Cristiano also played for an amateur team, where his talent was noticed by football selectors. From then on, Ronaldo's rapid rise as a football player began. He changed many famous clubs, became a repeated winner of the Ballon d'Or, won the Champions League and local championships, and finally became the most expensive football player in the world. Dir.: Anthony Vonk. Starring: Dolores Aveiro, Hugo Aveiro, Georgie Bingham, Adrian Clarke, Rio Ferdinand, Claudia Garcia, David Alvarez Izquierdo, Rhiannon Jones, Nelvino Lima, Miguel Lopez Marquez. programme.desc: Tập 1Tháng 9 năm 1994. Tổng thống Pháp François Mitterrand phải xoay sở cuộc sống chung phức tạp với Thủ tướng Édouard Balladur. programme.title: BÍ MẬT MITTERRAND - MITTERRAND CONFIDENTIEL

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP14
programme.desc: Một người đàn ông có khát vọng viết tiểu thuyết tội phạm đã trở thành ngôi sao trong câu chuyện đột phá của chính mình khi anh ta cố gắng trốn thoát khỏi một trong những trang trại nhà tù lâu đời nhất và khét tiếng nhất Mississippi, Parchman Penitentiary.

programme.title: HAZARDOUS HISTORY WITH HENRY WINKLER S1 EP01
programme.desc: Bạn có nhớ khi tuổi thơ đến với một bên nguy hiểm? Hãy nghĩ lại những món đồ chơi kỳ quặc và những trò hề liều lĩnh ở sân chơi từng được định nghĩa là sự trưởng thành, khi chúng tôi khám phá những bộ dụng cụ khoa học bùng nổ và hơn thế nữa.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP06
programme.desc: Chạy đua với cơn bão đang ập tới, Darrell Miklos và đội của anh buộc phải đưa ra những lựa chọn khó khăn. Nhưng sau một cuộc tìm kiếm kéo dài cả mùa giải, họ đã xác định được nguồn gốc của cú va chạm từ kế khổng lồ được ghi lại ở Mục tiêu 4.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP13
programme.desc: Chúng được gọi là bí ẩn khảo cổ vĩ đại nhất thế giới. Những hình vẽ 2.000 năm tuổi được tạo ra ở sa mạc Peru trải dài hơn 50 dặm. Các bức vẽ rất đồ sộ, chúng có thể được nhìn thấy từ trên không.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP24

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S16 EP257
programme.desc: Từ các tộc trưởng trong Kinh thánh cho đến những kẻ bắt cóc người ngoài hành tinh thời hiện đại, đã có những người tuyên bố có liên hệ với các sinh vật ở thế giới khác. Có thể nào họ đã được chọn để giúp thực hiện chương trình nghị sự của người ngoài hành tinh?

programme.desc: Trong nhiều thế kỷ, những đồ tạo tác mạnh mẽ đã gây ra chiến tranh, truyền cảm hứng cho những truyền thuyết và hình thành nên các đế chế. Từ vũ khí thần thánh đến thánh tích - đây là những câu chuyện đáng kinh ngạc về những kỳ quan hùng mạnh nhất thế giới.

programme.title: THE DEATH COAST EP04
programme.desc: Nhóm của Jeff MacKinnon chiến đấu với tảo bẹ dày đặc, dòng chảy dữ dội và cơn bão sắp xảy ra trong khi tìm kiếm bờ biển Đảo Scatarie. Ngay khi cơn bão ập đến, họ phát hiện ra một điều quan trọng.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP05
programme.desc: Hạn hán và nhiệt độ oi bức khiến mực nước giảm xuống mức thấp nhất trong nhiều thập kỷ và việc tiếp cận những hố mật tốt nhất trong đầm lầy gần như không thể vượt qua được. Thợ săn chấp nhận rủi ro rất lớn để điền vào thẻ.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP12
programme.desc: Lauro gần cuối Iditarod, băng qua 260 dặm băng dọc theo bờ Biển Bering để về đích ở Nome; Marty và người bạn Dave chuyên chở đồ cho một căn nhà gỗ ở vùng hẻo lánh.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP12
programme.desc: Bằng chứng ngày càng rõ ràng và nhóm tin rằng cuối cùng họ cũng đã tập trung vào Kho báu. Với sự tự tin ở mức cao nhất mọi thời đại, Hiệp hội chuẩn bị lấy lại nó khi họ gọi các caisson.

programme.title: SECRETS DECLASSIFIED WITH DAVID DUCHOVNY S1 EP03
programme.desc: Sự nguy hiểm, cảm xúc và gian khổ của các hoạt động lén lút chưa bao giờ được cảm nhận sâu sắc hơn những người sử dụng các nhân cách hoàn toàn riêng biệt để hòa nhập vào thế giới ngầm đen tối.

programme.title: 1942: FIGHTING FOR INDIA: THE WOMEN WHO DARED
programme.desc: Khi người Anh đang trong tình trạng chiến tranh suy yếu, những phụ nữ trẻ có lý tưởng từ các đồn điền cao su ở Malaya đã tham gia cùng Chandra Bose trong cuộc chiến giành độc lập của Ấn Độ.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP05

programme.title: BLOOMBERG DAYBREAK: EUROPE

programme.title: BLOOMBERG: THE OPENING TRADE

programme.title: THANH XÀ - TIỀN DUYÊN - THE FATE OF REUNION
programme.desc: Hàng ngàn năm trước, Green Snake đã được giác ngộ dưới sự hướng dẫn của Dao Qing và dần dần yêu anh ta. Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết. Kể từ đó, cô bắt đầu tìm kiếm những tái sinh của Đạo Thanh trong hàng trăm năm để giúp anh đảo ngược tình thế…

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau cái chết bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học Monkey Muay Thai và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Em gái của người yêu anh, người luyện tập Kung Fu Trung Quốc, ban đầu nghi ngờ Neua phải chịu trách nhiệm, nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng em gái cô đã bị giết bởi một nhóm tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ hợp lực để bảo vệ công lý và tìm cách báo thù.

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. Tào Tháo cố gắng chiêu mộ Quan Vũ vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Quan trung thành với người anh em kết nghĩa Lưu Bị, cũng là kẻ thù của Tào Tháo. Khi Quan cố gắng giải cứu vợ lẽ của Lưu Bị khỏi tay Tào Tháo, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu để vượt qua. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.
